verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यम् प्रश्रितम् धर्म संहितम् ।स्वामि सत्कार संयुक्तम् अंगदो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-५५-१॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyam praśritam dharma saṁhitam ।svāmi satkāra saṁyuktam aṁgado vākyam abravīt ॥4-55-1॥

translations.english: On hearing Hanuman's humble words (of advice) consistent with righteousness and full of devotion to his master, the king, Angada said:
translations.hindi: जिस पर्वत पर वे सब वानर मरने के लिए बेठे हुए थे, उसी 'पर्वेत पर एक गृघधराज आ उपस्थित हुआ

verses.sloka: स्थैर्यमात्ममनःशौचमानृशंस्यमथाअर्जवम् - यद्व -स्थैर्यम् आत्म मनः शौचम् आनृशंस्यम् अथ आर्जवम् ।विक्रमः चैव धैर्यम् च सुग्रीवे न उपपद्यते ॥४-५५-२॥
verses.transliteration: sthairyamātmamanaḥśaucamānṛśaṁsyamathāarjavam - yadva -sthairyam ātma manaḥ śaucam ānṛśaṁsyam atha ārjavam ।vikramaḥ caiva dhairyam ca sugrīve na upapadyate ॥4-55-2॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva has no steadfastness, purity of body and mind, compassion, rectitude, valour and patience.
translations.hindi: उस ग्रंघगाज का नाम सम्पाति था और वह बहुत बूढ़ा पक्षी था । बई प्रसिद्ध बलवान और पराक्रमी तथा शोभायुक्त जटायु का भाई था

verses.sloka: भ्रातुः ज्येष्ठस्य यो भार्याम् जीवितो महिषीम् प्रियाम् ।धर्मेण मातरम् यः तु स्वीकरोति जुगुप्सितः ॥४-५५-३॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātuḥ jyeṣṭhasya yo bhāryām jīvito mahiṣīm priyām ।dharmeṇa mātaram yaḥ tu svīkaroti jugupsitaḥ ॥4-55-3॥

translations.english: 'He usurped his elder brother's queen, while he was still alive. It is morally abominable since an elder brother's wife is like a mother. How can a person who blocks the entrance of a cave while his noble brother is engaged in fighting inside be treated as righteous?
translations.hindi: बह उस सहागिरि बिन्ध्याचल की एक गुफा से निकल और बानरों को वहाँ बैठा देख, बहुत प्रसन्न हुआ और यह वचन खोला

verses.sloka: कथम् स धर्मम् जानीते येन भ्रात्रा दुरात्मना ।युद्धाय अभिनियुक्तेन बिलस्य पिहितम् मुखम् ॥४-५५-४॥
verses.transliteration: katham sa dharmam jānīte yena bhrātrā durātmanā ।yuddhāya abhiniyuktena bilasya pihitam mukham ॥4-55-4॥

translations.english: 'He usurped his elder brother's queen, while he was still alive. It is morally abominable since an elder brother's wife is like a mother. How can a person who blocks the entrance of a cave while his noble brother is engaged in fighting inside be treated as righteous?
translations.hindi: निश्चय ही प्राणियों को, उन अच्छे बुरे फल भिला करते हैं के पूर्वाज्ित कर्मा के फलानुसार । देखो, उसीदे बहुत दिन्नँ वाद यह भोजन मुझे कुणा! ड मिला हे

verses.sloka: सत्यात् पाणि गृहीतः च कृत कर्मा महायशाः ।विस्मृतो राघवो येन स कस्य सुकृतम् स्मरेत् ॥४-५५-५॥
verses.transliteration: satyāt pāṇi gṛhītaḥ ca kṛta karmā mahāyaśāḥ ।vismṛto rāghavo yena sa kasya sukṛtam smaret ॥4-55-5॥

translations.english: 'Illustrious Rama, who faithfully held his hand was forgotten after he received his help. Indeed whose help would he remember?
translations.hindi: इन वानरों में से जो जो मरते जाँयगे क्रम से में उन उनको खाता जाऊंगा उन वानरों को देख, जब सम्पाति ने इस प्रकार कहा

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणस्य भयेन इह न अधर्म भय भीरुणा ।आदिष्टा मार्गितुम् सीताम् धर्मः तस्मिन् कथम् भवेत् ॥४-५५-६॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya bhayena iha na adharma bhaya bhīruṇā ।ādiṣṭā mārgitum sītām dharmaḥ tasmin katham bhavet ॥4-55-6॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva ordered search for Sita out of fear of Lakshmana and not out of fear of unrighteousness. How can such a man be pious?
translations.hindi: तब उस्र भोजनभट्ट पक्षी की ये बातें सुन, अंगद अति खिन्न हो हनुमान्‌ जी से कहने लगे

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् पापे कृतघ्ने तु स्मृति भिन्ने चल आत्मनि ।आर्यः को विश्वसेत् जातु तत् कुलीनो विशेषतः ॥४-५५-७॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin pāpe kṛtaghne tu smṛti bhinne cala ātmani ।āryaḥ ko viśvaset jātu tat kulīno viśeṣataḥ ॥4-55-7॥

translations.english: 'He is a sinner and an ungrateful person as he does not remember others' help. He is fickleminded. Which respectable person will believe him? Which member of his family will wish to live?
translations.hindi: देखो हम लोग तो सीता को ढू ने आण थे, परन्तु यहद साक्षात्‌ यमराज के समान, वानरों पर विपत्ति डालने को यहाँ आया है

verses.sloka: राज्ये पुत्रः प्रतिष्ठाप्यः स गुणो निर्गुणो अपि वा ।कथम् शत्रु कुलीनम् माम् सुग्रीवो जीवयिष्यति ॥४-५५-८॥
verses.transliteration: rājye putraḥ pratiṣṭhāpyaḥ sa guṇo nirguṇo api vā ।katham śatru kulīnam mām sugrīvo jīvayiṣyati ॥4-55-8॥

translations.english: 'If I am the king's son, virtuous or otherwise, I will be installed in the kingdom (as successor). How can Sugriva suffer me to live when I am his enemy's descendant?
translations.hindi: हस लोगों से न दो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ही का कोई काम चन पड़ा ओर न हम सुग्रीव की आज्ञा का पालन ही कर सके। तिस पर इस समय वानरों के लिए एह अनजानी विपत्ति आ उपस्थित हो गई

verses.sloka: भिन्न मन्त्रो अपराद्धः च हीन शक्तिः कथम् हि अहम् ।किष्किन्धाम् प्राप्य जीवेयम् अनाथ इव दुर्बलः ॥४-५५-९॥
verses.transliteration: bhinna mantro aparāddhaḥ ca hīna śaktiḥ katham hi aham ।kiṣkindhām prāpya jīveyam anātha iva durbalaḥ ॥4-55-9॥

translations.english: 'My alternate strategy has failed. I have already made a mistake (by announcing my plan). My advisors are holding different views. I am powerless. How can a weakling, an orphan like me live in Kishkinda?

verses.sloka: उपांशु दण्डेन हि माम् बंधनेन उपपादयेत् ।शठः क्रूरो नृशंसः च सुग्रीवो राज्य कारणात् ॥४-५५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: upāṁśu daṇḍena hi mām baṁdhanena upapādayet ।śaṭhaḥ krūro nṛśaṁsaḥ ca sugrīvo rājya kāraṇāt ॥4-55-10॥

translations.english: 'Sugriva is deceitful, cruel and treacherous. He will inflict secret punishment on me by way of imprisonment for the sake of the kingdom.
translations.hindi: क्या पशु और क्या पक्षी, जितने प्राणी हैं, वे सव अपने प्राणों को देकर भी, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के प्रियकार्य को वै पे ही करते हैं, जैसे कि हम सब

verses.sloka: बंधनात् च अवसादात् मे श्रेयः प्रायोपवेशनम् ।अनुजानंतु माम् सर्वे गृहम् गच्छंतु वानराः ॥४-५५-११॥
verses.transliteration: baṁdhanāt ca avasādāt me śreyaḥ prāyopaveśanam ।anujānaṁtu mām sarve gṛham gacchaṁtu vānarāḥ ॥4-55-11॥

translations.english: 'It is better for me to fast unto death rather than suffer imprisonment. Permit me to do so. You may all go back.
translations.hindi: श्रोरामचन्द्र जी के स्नेह ओर करुणा के वशवर्ती हो प्राणी भात्र एक दूसरे का उपकार करते हें । अतएव श्रोरामचन्द्र जो के उपकार के लिए, अपने आप र शरीर अर्पण कर, धमज्ञ जटायु ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का प्रियकाय सावन क्रिआ। हम लोग भो. ओरासचन्द्र जो के काम के लिए अपने प्राणों को हथेली पर रख कर ओर परिश्रम उठा क२,

verses.sloka: अहम् वः प्रतिजानामि न गमिष्यामि अहम् पुरीम् ।इह एव प्रायम् आसिष्ये श्रेयो मरणम् एव मे ॥४-५५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: aham vaḥ pratijānāmi na gamiṣyāmi aham purīm ।iha eva prāyam āsiṣye śreyo maraṇam eva me ॥4-55-12॥

translations.english: 'I swear I will not return to the city. I will fast unto death here only. Death for me is desirable.

verses.sloka: अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राजा कुशलम् एव च ।अभिवादन पूर्वम् तु राघवौ बलशालिनौ ॥४-५५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: abhivādana pūrvam tu rājā kuśalam eva ca ।abhivādana pūrvam tu rāghavau balaśālinau ॥4-55-13॥

translations.english: 'Convey my greetings with due courtesy to Rama and Lakshmana on my behalf and my respects to my father's younger brother, king of monkeys, Sugriva and wish him well.
translations.hindi: स चोर वन में ४ आए हैं, परन्तु क्या करें, सोता जी को न ख पाए । वह गुप्रराज जटायु जा रण में रावण द्वारा मारा गया बड़ः सुखी हुआ और सुप्री के भय से छूट उसने मोक्ष पाई। जटः्यु और दशरथ के मरने से,

verses.sloka: वाच्यः तातः यवीयान् मे सुग्रीवो वानर ईश्वरः ।आरोग्य पूर्वम् कुशलम् वाच्या माता रुमा च मे ॥४-५५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: vācyaḥ tātaḥ yavīyān me sugrīvo vānara īśvaraḥ ।ārogya pūrvam kuśalam vācyā mātā rumā ca me ॥4-55-14॥

translations.english: 'You should convey my mother as well as Ruma my good wishes for their health and wellbeing. You should console my mother Tara also.

verses.sloka: मातरम् चैव मे ताराम् आश्वासयितुम् अर्हथ ।प्रकृत्या प्रिय पुत्रा सा सानुक्रोशा तपस्विनी ॥४-५५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: mātaram caiva me tārām āśvāsayitum arhatha ।prakṛtyā priya putrā sā sānukrośā tapasvinī ॥4-55-15॥

translations.english: 'By nature my mother, is compassionate. She is fond of me. (But) she is helpless. On hearing about my death, she will certainly give up her life'.
translations.hindi: ओर सीता के हरण से, हम सब वानरों के प्राण संशय में पड़ गए | श्रीरासचन्द्र जी, लक्ष्मण ओर सीता.क्रा वनवास, श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी के बाण से वालिका वध ओर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के कोप से जनस्थानवासी समस्त राक्षसा का वध-ये समस्त अनं केकेयी के बरदान के कारण हुए हैं

verses.sloka: विनष्टम् माम् इह श्रुत्वा व्यक्तम् हास्यति जीवितम् ।एतावत् उक्त्वा वचनम् वृद्धान् तान् अभिवाद्य च ॥४-५५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: vinaṣṭam mām iha śrutvā vyaktam hāsyati jīvitam ।etāvat uktvā vacanam vṛddhān tān abhivādya ca ॥4-55-16॥

translations.english: Having expresed so much of his feelings, disheartened Angada saluted the elderly monkeys and started crying. Then he spread the darbha grass and lay down on the ground.

verses.sloka: विवेश अंगदो भूमौ रुदन् दर्भेषु दुर्मनाः ।तस्य संविशतः तत्र रुदन्तो वानर ऋषभाः ॥४-५५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: viveśa aṁgado bhūmau rudan darbheṣu durmanāḥ ।tasya saṁviśataḥ tatra rudanto vānara ṛṣabhāḥ ॥4-55-17॥

translations.english: Seeing him lie down the bulls among the monkeys became sad and shed hot tears from their eyes.

verses.sloka: नयनेभ्यः प्रमुमुचुः उष्णम् वै वारि दुःखिताः ।सुग्रीवम् चैव निन्दन्तः प्रशंसन्तः च वालिनम् ॥४-५५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: nayanebhyaḥ pramumucuḥ uṣṇam vai vāri duḥkhitāḥ ।sugrīvam caiva nindantaḥ praśaṁsantaḥ ca vālinam ॥4-55-18॥

translations.english: Blaming Sugriva and praising Vali, all the companions of Angada sat there surrounding him after having decided to fast unto death .

verses.sloka: परिवार्य अंगदम् सर्वे व्यवस्यन् प्रायम् आसितुम् ।तत् वाक्यम् वालि पुत्रस्य विज्ञाय प्लवग ऋषभाः ॥४-५५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: parivārya aṁgadam sarve vyavasyan prāyam āsitum ।tat vākyam vāli putrasya vijñāya plavaga ṛṣabhāḥ ॥4-55-19॥

translations.english: With the opinion of Vali's son ascertained, all the great monkeys thought it proper to die. They sipped water and assembled on the northern shore of the sea facing the east with the darbha grass spread on the ground, their edges pointing southward.

verses.sloka: उपस्पृश्य उदकम् सर्वे प्राक् मुखाः समुपाविशन् ।दक्षिण अग्रेषु दर्भेषु उदक् तीरम् समाश्रिताः ॥४-५५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: upaspṛśya udakam sarve prāk mukhāḥ samupāviśan ।dakṣiṇa agreṣu darbheṣu udak tīram samāśritāḥ ॥4-55-20॥

translations.english: With the opinion of Vali's son ascertained, all the great monkeys thought it proper to die. They sipped water and assembled on the northern shore of the sea facing the east with the darbha grass spread on the ground, their edges pointing southward.

verses.sloka: मुमूर्षवओ हरिश्रेष्टा एतत् क्षमम् इति स्म ह ।रामस्य वन वासम् च क्षयम् दशरथस्य च ॥४-५५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: mumūrṣavao hariśreṣṭā etat kṣamam iti sma ha ।rāmasya vana vāsam ca kṣayam daśarathasya ca ॥4-55-21॥

translations.english: Overtaken by the fear of death, the monkeys kept talking about Rama's exile into the forest, Dasaratha's death, destruction of demons in Janasthana, the death of Jatayu, abduction of Sita, Vali's death and Rama's anger.

verses.sloka: जनस्थान वधम् चैव वधम् चैव जटायुषः ।हरणम् चैव वैदेह्या वालिनः च वधम् तथा ।राम कोपम् च वदताम् हरीणाम् भयम् आगतः ॥४-५५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: janasthāna vadham caiva vadham caiva jaṭāyuṣaḥ ।haraṇam caiva vaidehyā vālinaḥ ca vadham tathā ।rāma kopam ca vadatām harīṇām bhayam āgataḥ ॥4-55-22॥

translations.english: Overtaken by the fear of death, the monkeys kept talking about Rama's exile into the forest, Dasaratha's death, destruction of demons in Janasthana, the death of Jatayu, abduction of Sita, Vali's death and Rama's anger.

verses.sloka: स संविशद्भिः बहुभिः महीधरोमहाअद्रि कूट प्रमितैः प्लवंगमैः ।बभूव सन्नादित निर्दर अन्तरोभृशम् नदद्भिः जलदैः इव अंबरम् ॥४-५५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: sa saṁviśadbhiḥ bahubhiḥ mahīdharomahāadri kūṭa pramitaiḥ plavaṁgamaiḥ ।babhūva sannādita nirdara antarobhṛśam nadadbhiḥ jaladaiḥ iva aṁbaram ॥4-55-23॥

translations.english: While the numerous monkeys, resembling peaks of high mountains were roaring, it resounded through the mountain caves. It was like the sound of the stormy thunderclouds. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfifth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
